job.job_title: Here is An Exciting Opportunity - GEN AI Engineer - Capgemini
job.job_description:
Below is the Job Description:

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

Experience: 4-12 years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on Python and libraries like NumPy, Panda, Scikit-learn etc
Generative AI: Proven expertise in LLM implementations, LangChain (or similar orchestration frameworks), Agentic AI, and RAG pipelines.
Machine Learning: Solid understanding of foundational Machine Learning concepts, algorithms, and workflows.
Web Frameworks: Strong hands-on experience building robust APIs using Flask, Django, FastAPI, or equivalent Python frameworks.
Data & Storage: Good understanding of structured and unstructured data, modelling and exceptional SQL skills with deep knowledge of database design and query optimization. Database Postgres/MS SQL/ Oracle
Cloud : Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, Azure

Professional & Soft Skills

Autonomy: Proven ability to work independently, self-manage, and resolve engineering blockers proactively.
Adaptability: Thrives in fast-paced, high-pressure, and agile delivery environments.
Mindset: A continuous learner with a growth mindset, passionate about keeping up with rapid advancements in AI.
Communication: Excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills to work effectively within a team.
Availability: Immediate or near-immediate availability to join the team is highly preferred.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Skills

DevOps Practice: Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code.
Full-Stack Capability: Basic front-end development experience (React, Vue, or Angular) to build internal tool prototypes.
